title: AI automations that don't fail silently
excerpt: Write the workflow in plain words. Kavela runs it in your tools and checks every run before it reaches you, on your Claude or Codex plan. 14-day free trial, no card.
content_html:
Kavela

Write it in plain words. Kavela runs it in your tools and checks every run.

Piloting with

Only 6.6% of developers trust AI with important work decisions. Nearly half trust it only when they can check it. Kavela checks every run, so you don't have to.

Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2026

Workflows anyone can read.

Write it in plain words. The steps are drawn for you, and anyone on the team can change it by saying what should change.

Runs when you need it
On a schedule, when something happens, or when you press Run.

Every change is a version
Look back at what changed, and when.

A reviewer on every run
It holds each run to the checklist you set.

Agents that come trained.

Every agent has a soul, playbooks for its job and a memory of the rules you have taught it.

Playbooks from the source
Written by the makers of the tools it uses.

Its own cloud computer
A real browser and files, apart from every other agent.

Your plan or ours
Your Claude or Codex plan, or the included Kav 1.0.

Turn a conversation into a running automation.

Tell Kav the job in plain words. It sets up the workflow, connects the apps, puts the right agents on it and runs it.

Nothing to build
The workflow, the app connections and the agents all come from what you said.

Nothing to staff
Kav puts the right agent on each part of the job, and builds one when none fits.

Nothing to chase
Every task is tracked on your board, and weak work goes back until it passes the check.

Work you don't have to double-check.

Before anything reaches you, a second agent that didn't do the work checks it against your goal and your checklist.

Ready to use
What passes comes to you checked and marked done.

Small slips fixed first
Copy, format and style slips are fixed before you see them.

Wrong work never lands on you
It goes back with the exact gap and is redone. If three tries fall short, you're told what's missing.

What keeps it from failing silently.

  • Sign-ins refresh before they expire.

    A run never stops on a login that ran out overnight.

  • A login or CAPTCHA opens a live browser you clear once.

    Email codes it reads itself. Hand it back and it carries on.

  • Ask in one box. Kav finds the task it belongs to.

    No chats or sessions to keep track of. Your request joins that task and carries on with its context.

  • Works in any app with an MCP server, a key or a sign-in page.

    Connect it once and every agent in the workspace can use it.

Pay for the minutes your agents work.

Every plan has unlimited agents, a cloud computer for each and every connection. Your own Claude or Codex costs nothing extra.

Common questions.

Will I know when something goes wrong?

Yes. A reviewer checks every run against your checklist and sends the gap back. If it still falls short after three tries, it brings you the work and what is missing. Finished and failed runs are posted to your chat.

Do I need to write code?

No. Describe the job in the chat the way you would ask a teammate. Kav connects the apps it needs and sets it up in your workspace.

What tools can I connect to?

Any tool that works with MCP, OAuth 2.0, an API key or a browser login.

Will it send or post anything without asking me?

Not by default. Risky steps, like sending an email or publishing a post, wait in your approvals until you say yes. Your keys never reach the model.

How autonomous can the agent become?

As much as you allow. On Autonomous it signs up for the services a job needs and posts for you, asking only the first time. Supervised, the default, asks before anything leaves your workspace. Payments and anything destructive always ask.

What happens when my plan hits its limit?

The task waits and carries on after your plan resets. It never switches to paid credits on its own.

Can I hand a workflow to a client or a teammate?

Yes. They read the steps in plain words, connect their own accounts when asked, and change it by saying what should change. Every change is a new version.

Will it remember last week's work?

Yes. Files stay in the workspace, and when you ask about earlier work, Kav finds that chat and carries on from there.

How much does it cost?

Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial, no card. Bring your Claude or Codex subscription at no extra cost, or use the included Kav AI usage.

Delegate a task free

常见问题。

Will I know when something goes wrong?

是的。 A reviewer checks every run against your checklist and sends the gap back. If it still falls short after three tries, it brings you the work and what is missing. Finished and failed runs are posted to your chat.

Do I need to write code?

No. Describe the job in the chat the way you would ask a teammate. Kav connects the apps it needs and sets it up in your workspace.

What tools can I connect to?

Any tool that works with MCP, OAuth 2.0, an API key or a browser login.

Will it send or post anything without asking me?

Not by default. Risky steps, like sending an email or publishing a post, wait in your approvals until you say yes. Your keys never reach the model.

How autonomous can the agent become?

As much as you allow. On Autonomous it signs up for the services a job needs and posts for you, asking only the first time. Supervised, the default, asks before anything leaves your workspace. Payments and anything destructive always ask.

What happens when my plan hits its limit?

The task waits and carries on after your plan resets. It never switches to paid credits on its own.

Can I hand a workflow to a client or a teammate?

是的。 They read the steps in plain words, connect their own accounts when asked, and change it by saying what should change. Every change is a new version.

Will it remember last week's work?

是的。 Files stay in the workspace, and when you ask about earlier work, Kav finds that chat and carries on from there.

How much does it cost?

Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial, no card. Bring your Claude or Codex subscription at no extra cost, or use the included Kav AI usage.
